I agree Skip to content Get a USU Degree Close to Home USU Anywhere As Utah’s land-grant institution, Utah State University makes becoming a part of the Aggie Family possible, even without leaving your hometown. You can access the same quality degrees, faculty, research, and Aggie spirit statewide. We have a variety of degree options that fit your schedule and prepare you for a career. No matter where you attend, you'll graduate an Aggie. Your diploma will have the same three renowned words: Utah State University. Choose the nearest you!
